Subject: Presenter hand-off & day-of playbook for July 28 webinar

Hi team,

Quick note to get the internal hand-off started for the July 28 webinar with DataScience Inc. (Dr. Laura Jensen). Laura confirmed availability for 11:00 PT / 14:00 ET and would like a 20-minute presentation + 20-minute Q&A. We need to finalize who owns what on the day and lock the run-of-show.

Key asks:
- Marissa: can you own the guest liaison (pre-call, bio/headshot, logistics)?
- Lauren: can you take producer duties (Zoom room host, co-host, recording, tech checks)?
- Vivek: please own promo cadence and the calendar invite / speaker reminder flow.

I drafted a short playbook (attached) — it's not final but covers arrival windows, contingency plan if the guest loses audio, and cues for the Q&A.

Tentative run-of-show (45 min total):
- 10:55 PT: Host & producer join; tech check
- 11:00 PT: Welcome (2 min) — Marissa
- 11:02 PT: Intro & context (3 min) — Neha
- 11:05 PT: Guest presentation (20 min) — Dr. Laura Jensen
- 11:25 PT: Live demo / Redwood product highlight (5 min) — Vivek
- 11:30 PT: Q&A (10–15 min) — panel
- 11:45 PT: Close & CTA (2–3 min)

Attachments: presenter-playbook_v1.pdf (draft), webinar-day-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet with checkboxes).

Please reply with confirmations and any missing items by EOD Tuesday so I can send Laura the final run-of-show and a speaker reminder.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
